title: Expect Better from Government | Kasie Whitener for US Senate
description:
Dr. Kasie Whitener shares the frustration South Carolina voters feel - challenges like a $40T national debt and rampant corruption; and the optimism that we can overcome these challenges together. 

Vote better, South Carolina. Now's the time to choose true representation. @KasieSouthCarolina  #1MillionKnow 
 
Learn more at kasiesouthcarolina.com
transcript: I'm Dr. Kasey Whitenor. I'm running for U.S. Senate because South Carolina isready for independent, accessible representation. That's right,independent. I'm visiting all 46 counties, celebrating the things thatmake South Carolina great. We have real challenges, but we have realopportunities, too. Together, we can choose to put people ahead of party andspecial interests. Your vote for me on November 3rd says you expect better fromyour government. I'm Kasey Whitenor, and I approve this message.
